newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Equatorial recommends reject AMP bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Equatorial recommends reject AMP bid.

text.p: Equatorial Mining NL on Friday recommended shareholders reject the increased takeover offer of 30 cents a share by Quay Mining Pty Ltd, wholly-owned by Australian Mutual Provident (AMP) Society.
"The offer remains significantly below the low end of the independent expert's value range of 36 cents to 47 cents per share as assessed by Grant Samuel & Associates Pty Ltd," Equatorial said.
The offer is even further below the directors' view of both the current and potential value of Equatorial, it said.
Quay earlier on Friday raised its bid from 25 cents.
Quay, which said it was entitled to 34.8 percent of Equatorial shares, also extended the bid to February 27.
Quay said the offer was now free from conditions.
Equatorial Mining is involved in the development of the El Tesoro copper project in Chile which is expected to be in production in late 1998.
It also holds options to acquire two copper properties, located in the U.S. from Cyprus Climax Metals Co
The options cover the Mineral Park copper mine near Kingman, Arizona and the Tonopah copper ore body near Tonopah, Nevada.
